chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu al-Ward, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) preached to the people in the last Friday of Sha'ban. He praised Allah and extolled Him, then said: 'O people! A month has come over you in which there is a night better than a thousand months — it is the Month of Ramadan. Allah has obligated its fasting and made the standing of a night in it with voluntary prayer like the voluntary prayer of seventy nights in other months.

And He made, for whoever performs in it a voluntary act from among the good deeds and piety, [a reward] like the reward of one who fulfilled an obligation from the obligations of Allah, Mighty and Majestic; and whoever fulfills in it an obligation from the obligations of Allah is like one who fulfilled seventy obligations from the obligations of Allah in other months.

It is the month of patience, and verily the reward of patience is Paradise; and the month of mutual sympathy. It is a month in which Allah increases the provision of the believer. Whoever provides the iftar meal for a fasting believer in it shall have, due to that, before Allah: the emancipation of a slave and forgiveness for his past sins.

It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah, not all of us are able to provide the iftar for a fasting person.' He said: 'Allah is generous — He gives this reward to one who can only manage a sip of milk with which to break a faster's fast, or a drink of sweet water, or a few dates, if he cannot do more than that. And whoever lightens [the burden of] his owned slave in it, Allah will lighten His reckoning from him.

It is a month whose beginning is mercy, its middle is forgiveness, and its end is the answering [of supplication] and liberation from the Fire. You cannot do without four characteristics: two with which you please Allah, and two which you cannot do without. As for the two with which you please Allah, Mighty and Majestic: it is the testimony that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. And as for the two which you cannot do without: you ask Allah for your needs and Paradise, and you ask for well-being, and you seek refuge in Him from the Fire.
